entities.summary: Ōnakatomi no Yoshinobu , also Ōnakatomi no Yoshinobu Ason (大中臣能宣朝臣), was a middle Heian period Japanese nobleman and waka poet. He is designated as a member of the Thirty-six Poetry Immortals, and one of his poems is included in the Ogura Hyakunin Isshu, but one theory holds that his entry in this anthology was not actually written by him.
